narrative: 方向就是揭示的顺序。向右横移可以揭示一个原本被合理地藏在画面右侧之外的倾听者、一扇门或一处威胁。
水平线保持水平，只有世界在滑动。如果摄影机应该转头一瞥，或者几厘米的滑轨移动就足够了，这就不是合适的工具。
选择能产生信息的一侧，而不是为了装饰性的滑动。
how: 平行铺轨，高度和俯仰角保持不变，除非刻意组合运动，否则不要用摇镜头来补偿。保持水平线锁定。
提示词：向右横移推轨，平滑的侧向移动，分层视差，水平线锁定。
when: 与推轨左移方向相反：选择能揭示新信息的方向。具体场景：沿车身侧面向右滑动，直到第二名乘客出现。
不要在同一镜头里毫无理由地来回横移。
vs: 推轨左移（Dolly Left）是同样的物理原理、方向相反。向右摇（Pan Right）只有旋转，没有位移。
当主体也在移动时，跟拍镜头（Tracking Shot）会用到这条横向轴线；而推轨右移也可以用来扫视一排静止的对象。滑轨镜头（Slider Shot）是同一种线性运动的短距版本。
examples_film: 《人类之子》（Children of Men）常常让摄影机在真实街道中位移，而不是从固定机头上转头一瞥。《幕后玩家》（The Player）片场那场长镜头中，横向移动是更长调度中的一部分。
把这种侧移当作语法来学习，而不是照搬整个一镜到底。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是向右摇（Pan Right），或者一个开始弯曲的360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）。破绽在于机头转动、水平线倾斜下沉，或摄影机与主体的距离发生变化。
解决办法：直线轨道、纯向右平移，如果要保持对主体的框取，就维持与主体的恒定半径。

faq.q: 电影中的推轨右移（Dolly Right）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机在轮子或轨道上向右侧平移，镜头保持指向不变，背景以视差方式层层剥离。

faq.q: 推轨右移（Dolly Right）与向右摇（Pan Right）的区别
faq.a: 向右摇是固定支撑上的旋转。推轨右移则是让支撑装置本身移动位置，使近处物体比远处物体经过得更快。

faq.q: 什么时候该用推轨右移（Dolly Right）？
faq.a: 当你需要的叙事信息在画面右侧、并且应该通过移动去抵达时使用。不要把它当作固定镜头的默认润色手法。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写推轨右移（Dolly Right）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：沿轨道向右推轨，不使用摇镜头，水平线锁定，分层视差，主体保持在画面中。并说明从右侧进入画面的是什么。

narrative: Direction is a reveal order. Trucking right can disclose a listener, a door, or a threat that was legally off-screen to camera right.
The horizon stays level; only the world slides. It is the wrong tool when the camera should yaw to glance, or when a few centimeters of slider would be enough.
Pick the side that produces information, not a decorative glide.
how: Track parallel, height and tilt constant, no compensatory pan unless you are combining moves on purpose. Keep the horizon locked.
Prompt a lateral dolly right, smooth sideways travel, layered parallax, locked horizon.
when: Use the opposite of dolly left: pick the direction that reveals new information. Concrete beat: sliding right along a car's profile until a second passenger appears.
Do not truck both ways in one clip without a reason.
vs: Dolly Left is the same physics mirrored. A Pan Right only rotates.
Tracking Shot uses this lateral axis when the subject is also moving; dolly right can scan a still lineup. A Slider Shot is a short version of the same linear idea.
examples_film: Children of Men often relocates the camera through real streets rather than glancing from a locked head. The Player 's studio-lot sentence includes lateral travel as part of a longer choreography.
Take the side-slip as grammar, not the whole oner.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Pan Right or an 360-Degree Orbit that starts to curve. The tell is yaw, a dipping horizon, or a changing camera-to-subject distance.
The fix: straight track, rightward translation, constant radius to the subject if you are holding them.

faq.q: What is Dolly Right in film?
faq.a: It is a sideways translation of the camera to the right on wheels or track, with the lens holding its aim and the background peeling in parallax.
Pan right is rotation from a fixed support. Dolly right relocates the support, so near objects pass faster than distant ones.

faq.q: When should I use Dolly Right?
faq.a: When the story fact you need is to camera right and should be reached by travel. Do not use it as a default polish on a lock-off.

faq.q: How do I prompt Dolly Right for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write dolly right on track, no pan, locked horizon, layered parallax, subject kept in frame. State what enters from the right.
